entries.previous:
Cut the edges at a vertex v that is adjacent to all the others and nothing else. This is the limit of the Aronov–O'Rourke star unfolding as the source point moves to v: for a source in the interior of a face the star unfolding is known to be non-overlapping, and non-overlap is a closed condition, so the limit is non-overlapping too (touching is allowed).

Why it settles so muchWith at most six vertices, a vertex of degree n − 1 exists in every type except the prism, the prism with one diagonal, the octahedron minus an edge, and the octahedron.
